meta.title: Improve entity destroy performance
meta.body_summary: Optimize Entity.destroy by avoiding BitSet allocation and iterating via an array, and simplify the corresponding benchmark.

perf_labels.notes: Codex-authored micro-optimization of Entity.destroy with no review; merged instantly after author self-approval.

review_details.performance_claim: Avoid allocating a new BitSet during entity destruction, iterating via array instead.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Micro-optimization within a single method in an ECS library is well within agent technical capability; merge friction was zero due to author's immediate self-merge.

core_change_summary.description: In src/Entity.ts, Entity.destroy now avoids allocating a temporary BitSet; instead it iterates over an existing array directly. The benchmarks/elics.js benchmark was simplified to iterate the query set directly.
